latest.title: Supply by shop, warehouse and factory, and staffing for factory lines
latest.summary: Supply is now three tabs, one per object: Shops, Warehouses and Factories. Each opens on what needs a change, with the figure to type beside the setting it changes and a tick at the head of the row; one checklist under the tabs counts your ticks across all three and copies what is left. Idle stock folds into one row per warehouse or per cause, a shelf topped up far above what it sells gets a lower target to type, and the goods-flow diagram is a view of each tab: click a site to see its rows. Factories shows the hours each line is rostered against the hours it needs, 24/7 or for what your shops use, and too few hours is a change to type. A new Staffing for factory lines block gives each line's shifts, the factory workers the plan needs against those you have, and what the difference does to your wages. This answers the voted request "Supply chain for factories not running 24/7".
